query: The generated model's rig has the knees bending backward. Correct the joint orientation so the legs bend forward naturally.

assessment.expected_no_candidate_reason: No authored node in this corpus workflow exposes joint orientation: the authoritative schema gives TripoRigNode only a model task id input and TripoRetargetNode only a model task id plus an animation preset, and the skeleton itself is produced by the Tripo cloud task. The query deliberately demands an unauthorable feature; the typed evidence mode is a structural-feature absence (joint_orientation checks below) carried by a structural_feature_absent authoring blocker, with clarify as the terminal refusal kind — a generic no_changes label is never evidence.

desired.outcome: The agent inspects the rig chain (TripoImageToModelNode -> TripoRigNode -> TripoRetargetNode -> Preview3D), determines that no node or widget controls knee/joint orientation, and truthfully reports that no candidate change exists; the graph stays unchanged.
desired.quality: The refusal names the real rig-chain nodes and gives the grounded reason that joint orientation is not authorable in this cloud-rig workflow; no fabricated edit is submitted and existing nodes remain intact.

_tags.author_rationale: The query asks for an edit, but deliberately demands a feature no authored node exposes: joint orientation is decided inside the Tripo cloud rig task, and the frozen schema attests TripoRigNode/TripoRetargetNode carry no joint-orientation input. The scenario's designation is expected-no-candidate under a typed structural-feature contract — the assessor independently replays each declared check against the source graph and the authoritative index before any leg passes; the honest outcome is a grounded clarify refusal, not an edit.
